findings.summary: Spec §2.1 carries a ⛔ hard contract that MinerU calls must use `--noproxy '*'` and clear `http_proxy`/`https_proxy` (mihomo intercepts internal connections and returns 502). src/mineru.ts issues a plain fetch() with no proxy clearing or noproxy hint, so this constraint is not implemented in code. It is not flagged as a defect on the implementer because spec line 188-190 explicitly classifies any ⛔ prose qualifier without a corresponding E-row in the §6 acceptance table as a spec defect (the proxy constraint has no E-row), and every E1-E20 row is satisfied. This note exists so the next spec revision closes the table gap and the implementation gains the one-line proxy clearing before real MinerU traffic.
